about_short_description.short_description: Constant is the creator of the Vultr cloud computing and bare-metal platform.

product.name: Bare Metal Servers
product.description: Dedicated physical servers without virtualization, providing direct access to hardware resources for applications requiring non-virtualized environments.

product.name: Cloud Compute Instances
product.description: Virtualized compute resources including dedicated, shared, and high-frequency instances for scalable application deployment.

product.name: Object and Block Storage
product.description: Redundant storage solutions offering fast access and volumes up to 10TB for data storage needs.

product.name: Global Data Center Network
product.description: A network of 32 worldwide data centers enabling rapid deployment of cloud infrastructure across multiple regions.

product.name: Developer Tools and APIs
product.description: APIs and developer tools for automating infrastructure management, including password generators, subnet calculators, and MAC address converters.
